desc: Implement and validate an O(K·min(|S|,|T|))-time, O(K)-memory banded Levenshtein threshold DP with correct moving-band boundary handling.
Prove that restricting computation to `|i-j| <= K` cannot exclude an edit sequence of at most K operations.
Handle early rejection when `abs(len(S) - len(T)) > K`.
Implement stdin/stdout parsing and final `Yes`/`No` output in Python.
